## Walrus (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
 N Large animal  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +21  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 10, flat-footed 17 (+1 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 140 (10d8+60)  
 **Fort** +14, **Ref** +8, **Will** +4  
**Resist** cold 5  

**Offense**

 **Speed** swim 40 ft.  
 **Melee** gore +14 (1d10+7)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** trample (2d8+7, DC 22)  

**Statistics**

 **Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +15; **CMD** 26  
 **Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Focus (gore)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)
